newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian money supply raised, CD issue complete.
newsitem.headline: Belgian money supply raised, CD issue complete.

text.p: The Belgian National Bank said it added liquidity to the money market in the week to December 16 to compensate a rise in bank note circulation and of the state's deposits with the bank.

The bank also said in its weekly statement that it completed its certificats of deposit issuance programme. It issued 61.57 billion francs in the past week, boosting the total outstanding to 230 billion.
The CDs, which expire at the end of 1998 and have revisable rates, were issued to neutralise the impact on the money market of a 230 billion franc state debt buyback operation.
For the buyback, the bank used capital gains on gold sales in recent years.
(figures from the weekly statement in bln francs) -
* comprises repurchase agreements and interbank loans
